not_claimed: P0 is uniquely implied by Richards physics.
P0 is the physically correct unresolved subgrid profile.
P0 will improve C5R/C5N high-resolution error.
rationale: The only retained dynamic variable per layer is integrated water storage S_i. P0 projects the unresolved local storage tendency dtheta/dt onto the same lowest-order constant basis within that layer.
The exact layer balance dS_i/dt=q_top-q_bottom is preserved and unequal transient face fluxes are allowed.
No fitted coefficient, transform parameter, polynomial coordinate or new dynamic shape state is introduced.
Quadratic-pressure and transformed-potential profiles require an additional structural choice of reconstruction coordinate/order that is not selected by the retained storage state.
P0 is therefore the least-assumptive prospectively testable member of the admissible SCAFP families, not an evidence-fitted winner.

independent_literature_due_diligence.reference: Celia, Bouloutas & Zarba (1990), Water Resources Research 26(7), 1483-1496, doi:10.1029/WR026i007p01483
independent_literature_due_diligence.relevance: Mixed-form Richards discretization is mass conservative and emphasizes that treatment of the time/storage term is critical.
independent_literature_due_diligence.limitation: Does not derive the C5W P0 subgrid ansatz.

independent_literature_due_diligence.relevance: Finite-volume methods evolve cell-average conservative quantities; the lowest-order projection is piecewise constant.
independent_literature_due_diligence.limitation: General finite-volume theory, not a Richards-specific proof of uniform within-layer dtheta/dt.

independent_literature_due_diligence.reference: Manzini & Ferraris (2004), Advances in Water Resources 27(12), 1199-1215, doi:10.1016/j.advwatres.2004.08.008
independent_literature_due_diligence.relevance: Richards equation can be formulated with mass-conservative cell-centered finite volumes.
independent_literature_due_diligence.limitation: Does not uniquely prescribe the reduced-order subgrid profile.

independent_literature_due_diligence.reference: Finite-volume predictor-corrector 1D Richards study, Journal of Hydrology (2015), S0022169415000700
independent_literature_due_diligence.relevance: Cell-centered control-volume integration and explicit attention to mass conservation/intercell fluxes are standard Richards numerics.
independent_literature_due_diligence.limitation: Not an argument that P0 is uniquely correct.

within_layer: Darcy in the reduced convention gives dpsi/dz=q(z)/K(psi)-1.
Storage closure requires S_i=integral_0^d theta(psi(z)) dz.
layer_local_monotonicity_argument: For fixed top-face psi and q_top, treat q_bottom as the scalar shooting variable.
Sensitivity y=dpsi/dq_bottom satisfies a linear variational ODE with positive forcing xi/K(psi) when K>0 and y(0)=0, hence y(z)>0 on an admissible unsaturated trajectory.
For the unsaturated retention branch theta'(psi)<0, so d/dq_bottom integral theta(psi(z)) dz < 0.
Therefore the layer-storage shooting residual is strictly monotone in q_bottom wherever the trajectory stays inside the admissible constitutive domain; at most one layer-local q_bottom root exists.
unresolved_before_hydrological_test: Existence/bracketing of the layer-local root across the intended state domain.
Admissibility of trajectories near saturation/dry limits.
Monotonicity and uniqueness of the full-column outer map for prescribed top flux plus prescribed bottom head.
Conditioning and numerical robustness without response-derived bracket/tolerance tuning.
